observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor football stadium field and bleachers
observation.formation_and_space: horizontal rows and staggered formations across turf field and stadium bleachers
observation.posture: upright torso with flexible spine, soft knees, and athletic lower body stance
observation.footwork: fast repetitive stepping, jumps, kicks, and turns synchronized to energetic music
observation.arms_and_hands: sharp arm swings, overhead reaches, and hand-to-head framing
observation.hips_and_torso: rapid hip shakes, pelvic thrusts (bucking), and torso rolls
observation.levels_jumps_turns: high leg extensions, cartwheels, floor drops, and jumps
observation.costume_and_props: matching crop tops, leotards or two-piece sets with fringe or rhinestones, white boots, and fishnet tights
observation.cannot_infer: exact weight transfer and fast footwork details obscured by video compression and camera cuts

signature_moments.what: rapid hip shaking while squatting with sharp arm movements
cartwheels followed by immediate floor drops into splits
salt and pepper arm swing movement while stepping quickly
bucking with fast bouncing hips and sweeping arm extensions
